content_html: Hey, I’m mentioned in that podcast! Ben Day and I have consulted each other on NHibernate patterns…

Here I am doing research for a paper that I am writing (comparing NHibernate vs. ADO.NET data access) and I keep coming across your name! I guess that shouldn’t surprise me any. You do seem like you are very PRO NHibernate!!! I am getting there. But I still think I like having both channels open behind a repository or something.

Back to work…
